## What to do next (run in order)

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## What you should expect after running

1. **`aub_autopilot.py ... --select-best`**
   - Produces/updates candidate module variants from the registry.
   - Attempts to select the best-performing module-level candidate(s) relative to the champion.

2. **`system_autopilot.py ...`**
   - Runs end-to-end/system-level candidate specs from `system_candidates.yaml`.
   - This is where you typically get new PASS/INCONCLUSIVE outcomes at the system level.

3. **`aub_next_fix.py ...`**
   - Writes: `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`
   - Use this report to identify the most promising *actionable* next changes (e.g., weakest modules, failing tests, regressions).

## If you paste results here
If you share the console output (or the generated report paths + key metrics), I can:
- identify why no PASS candidates are being produced,
- pinpoint the biggest regressions/bottlenecks (especially “min” failures),
- recommend the next candidate edits to try.
